introduction: New Jersey weatherization accepts applications through DCAid and county-serving WAP agencies. The program assesses eligible homes for selected energy-saving improvements.
description: New Jersey weatherization accepts applications through DCAid and county-serving WAP agencies. The program assesses eligible homes for selected energy-saving improvements.

sections.who: Eligibility considers household circumstances, program income rules and the property. Discuss tenancy and owner permission with the local agency before arranging work.
sections.get: Approved work improves energy efficiency and may address qualifying heating-system or health-and-safety issues. The audit determines suitable measures; this is not an unrestricted renovation grant.
sections.docs:

  • Property address and residence information.
  • Ownership or lease details.
  • Utility information and landlord contact if requested.
sections.apply:
1. Start the WAP request

    Use DCAid; the state says its weatherization portal is open year-round.

  2. Complete the portal application

    Fill in qualifications, open the program application, upload records and sign before submitting.

  3. Work with the local agency

    Contact the agency serving your county about eligibility, property assessment and scheduling.
sections.after: Save the application ID. If the portal shows an existing incomplete request, resume it rather than creating another. Ask the provider about waiting and approved work.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using New Jersey WAP purpose and agency route, Portal availability, WAP application FAQ. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can I apply without internet access?
The state FAQ directs applicants to their local agency for application assistance.
Is the online qualification screen the whole application?
No. Complete the program application and submission steps too.
Does weatherization pay my current utility debt?
It arranges efficiency work; utility-bill assistance has a separate application.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
